title: DiagTrace: An Interactive Benchmark for Clinical Decision Making
abstract: arXiv:2611.22009v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong performance on medical question answering and diagnostic reasoning benchmarks. However, existing evaluations typically provide all patient information upfront and assess only the final diagnosis or rationale. This setup ignores the need to acquire diagnostic evidence incrementally from incomplete information in real-world diagnosis. To bridge this gap, we introduce DiagTrace, a source-grounded benchmark for evaluating whether LLMs can reconstruct the documented diagnostic trajectory through interactive information seeking. Each benchmark instance is built from a PubMed Central case report and includes an initial presentation, an event bank, a clinical course, and diagnostic references. DiagTrace contains 510 cases across eight specialties, with 225 used to evaluate four LLMs on clinical-course alignment, interaction quality, and efficiency. translated_title: DiagTrace：一个用于临床决策的交互式基准测试
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在医学问答和诊断推理基准测试中展现出强大的性能。然而，现有的评估通常预先提供患者的全部信息，并且仅评估最终诊断或推理理由。这种设置忽略了真实临床诊断中需要从不完整信息出发逐步获取诊断证据的需求。为弥补这一差距，我们提出了DiagTrace，这是一个基于真实文献来源的基准测试，用于评估LLM能否通过交互式信息获取来重建已被记录的诊断轨迹。每个基准实例均基于PubMed Central病例报告构建，包含初始临床表现、事件库、临床病程和诊断参考资料。DiagTrace包含覆盖八个专科的510个病例，其中225个用于评估四个LLM在临床病程对齐度、交互质量和效率方面的表现。结果显示模型在覆盖范围与信息源一致性等方面存在权衡。
tldr: DiagTrace是一个基于PubMed Central病例报告构建的交互式临床决策基准，包含510个跨八个专科的病例，用于评估大语言模型能否通过交互式信息获取从不完整信息中逐步重建诊断轨迹，突破了传统一次性提供完整患者信息的评估方式。
en_tdlr: DiagTrace is a source-grounded interactive benchmark built from PubMed Central case reports with 510 cases across eight specialties, designed to evaluate whether LLMs can incrementally reconstruct documented diagnostic trajectories through interactive information seeking, moving beyond traditional upfront full-information evaluation.
